definitions.explanation: How well air passes through a material or space, such as fabric, shoes, bedding or a building. Used often in product descriptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通気性|つうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。

examples.english: In summer I choose clothes that breathe well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{麻|あさ}→麻：27726_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通気性|つうきせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧だ。
examples.english: Linen is a fabric with excellent breathability.

examples.japanese: {通気性|つうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こもりやすい。
examples.english: If ventilation is poor, moisture tends to build up in the room.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通気性|つうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: breathes well / poorly
- {通気性|つうきせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to have excellent breathability
- {通気性|つうきせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve ventilation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通気|つうき}→通気：27363_tsuuki⟧: ventilation, airflow
- ⟦{風通|かぜとお}し→風通し：09032_kazetooshi⟧: airflow, draft (more everyday)
